"Master, don’t worry. I remember this matter, but I won’t be mentally disturbed by it. Revenge is a goal, but it is not my entire life."
Ning Qi said seriously.
Taoist Longshan felt relieved. What he feared most was Ning Qi harboring grievances, but after a candid conversation with Ning Qi today, he realized he had underestimated his disciple’s mindset; such calmness and resilience made him feel somewhat inadequate.
"The Blood Rain Tower is elusive. After the Celestial Being Grand Ceremony, I will start handling this matter. It won’t take long, I should have results, and by then, I will assist you."
Taoist Longshan spoke with confidence.
After all, the Blood Rain Tower is just a first-class force. Even with some means, it cannot withstand Taoist Longshan, who is already in the Celestial Human Realm, and many would be willing to do him a favor.
Ning Qi nodded and said:
"Master, by then, leave ’Feng’ among the ’Wind, Rain, Thunder, and Lightning’ to me. I want to take revenge personally."
Taoist Longshan was stunned.
The four gold assassins, Wind, Rain, Thunder, and Lightning, are all Gang Essence Realm experts, especially ’Feng,’ who has a record of assassinating a Primordial Core Realm opponent. That battle made the Blood Rain Tower famous, causing many first-class forces in Qing State to fear them.
At this moment, hearing Ning Qi say this, he couldn’t help but feel anxious.
"Qi’Er, you..."
Ning Qi smiled gently and said:
"Master, I have confidence."
Taoist Longshan gazed at Ning Qi, his heart stirred. If these words came from someone else, he would never believe it. An eight-year-old child saying he has confidence in defeating a Primordial Core Realm expert?
This is simply a fantasy.
Previously, Ning Qi being able to kill the Flying Heaven Eagle was already extraordinary, but the gap between the White Mist Realm and the Primordial Core Realm isn’t insignificant. Taoist Longshan himself took several decades to traverse from the White Mist Realm to the Primordial Core Realm.
But he knew, Ning Qi never exaggerated.
"Really?"
"Really."
Ning Qi and Taoist Longshan stared at each other, his expression was calm yet full of confidence.
A moment later.
Taoist Longshan took a deep breath and decided to personally test him.
No matter how much he believed in Ning Qi, he could not be careless. Wanting to personally take revenge is good, but he must have enough strength to do so.
Ning Qi’s eyes gradually filled with excitement. He was really curious about the strength of a Celestial Human Realm expert but never had the opportunity.
"If you can’t hold on, let me know at any time."
"Alright."
Master and disciple stood facing each other, ten yards apart.
As the words fell.
Taoist Longshan’s expression became solemn, and his Taoist robe slightly rippled. The Power of Heaven and Earth gradually gathered and then pressed down on Ning Qi like a huge mountain.
Ning Qi’s body trembled and immediately felt an invisible oppressive force.
Unlike the unconscious Power of Heaven and Earth fluctuation when Taoist Longshan broke through before, the current Power of Heaven and Earth was targeted suppression. Ning Qi suddenly felt like he was trapped in a swamp.
He slightly raised his hand and felt it took several times more effort than usual.
His body trembled, bones shook, and spine crackled.
The Gang Qi within his body could no longer resist, automatically circulating to withstand that omnipresent and increasingly strong oppression.
"No wonder Gang Essence Realm is powerless against Celestial Human Realm. They are simply not on the same level of power," Ning Qi thought to himself.
The mere suppression between heaven and earth was already so terrifying, let alone real combat. No wonder Ning Qi previously heard that the Primordial Core Realm Purple River Sword Venerate didn’t withstand even a few moves before being instantly defeated by his master.
Just imagine, two adults wrestling, one tied up by ropes; wouldn’t he be at the mercy of others?
Let ordinary Gang Essence Realm and Celestial Human Realm experts wrestle; it would be too much.
But Ning Qi was clearly not an ordinary Gang Essence Realm.
The vast Gang Qi within him suddenly surged, forcibly pushing away the oppressive Power of Heaven and Earth. Taoist Longshan’s eyes widened, and then he immediately increased the pressure, enveloping Ning Qi like an invisible cage.
Ning Qi’s Gang Qi transformed, like clouds and mist—elusive, and like water and marsh—ever-changing.
Taoist Longshan’s eyes opened wider.The most update n0vels are published on NovᴇlFɪre.ɴet
"What is this Gang Qi?"
As he applied the Power of Heaven and Earth, it felt like he was suppressing an eel—only a third of his force remained, either repelled, shifted, or absorbed. That mysterious Gang Qi was incredible, far from the existing Cultivation Techniques of the True Martial Sect.
Taoist Longshan marveled inwardly, realizing Ning Qi had already embarked on his own path.
Unknowingly, his Taoist robe billowed more violently.
He intended to test the limits of Ning Qi’s Gang Qi.
The Power of Heaven and Earth grew increasingly surging. The cliff winds were fierce, and although he didn’t make a move himself, Taoist Longshan no longer held back on the Power of Heaven and Earth.
Ning Qi was gradually struggling; resisting this incredible oppression required a tremendous amount of Gang Qi every moment. Even with his abundant Gang Qi, he found it difficult to withstand such consumption.
He roughly understood his own limits.
"Celestial Human Realm experts are indeed extraordinary. Although my current Gang Qi is vast, its quality is slightly lacking. Being able to hold on for a while is already quite impressive."
"Unless using the Ape King’s true form or the Unity of Heaven and Man Secret Techniques, forcibly tearing through this Power of Heaven and Earth’s suppression, or perhaps stepping into the Jade Liquid Realm, transforming the quality of Gang Qi entirely."
"In other words, if I go all out, I might barely contend with a newly entered Celestial Human Realm expert like Master. Whether I can win is uncertain, but I certainly won’t die. It shouldn’t be difficult for me to leave."
Ning Qi smiled inwardly, gaining a clearer understanding of his strength.
In that case, even without Taoist Longshan’s assistance, he could easily wipe out the Blood Rain Tower.
As thoughts whirled in his mind, Ning Qi spoke:
"Master, I can’t hold on any longer."
There was no need to reveal his trump cards when not confronting life and death.
Taoist Longshan slowly withdrew the Power of Heaven and Earth. He too was relieved internally. Ning Qi’s performance was too extraordinary; if he didn’t show weakness further, he might have to intervene personally.
Taoist Longshan marveled immensely inside.
Ning Qi was only eight years old!
With such performance now, even compared to before reaching the Celestial Human Realm, he couldn’t have done better. At that time, he was over eighty years old!
In comparison, he felt like he’d lived to a dog’s age.
Ning Qi smiled and asked:
"Master, how was it?"
Facing that expectant gaze, Taoist Longshan coughed lightly, trying to keep his complexion calm:
"Not bad."
He turned around, standing with his hands behind his back.
Such performance was far more than "not bad"; it was monstrous—capable of contending with a Primordial Core Realm with ease.
"Afterward, the gold assassin ’Feng’ from the Blood Rain Tower will be yours to deal with."
Taoist Longshan’s tone was calm, but the curve of his lips betrayed all of his current feelings.

chapters.title: Chapter 78 - 72: An Ant Gazing at the Sky
chapters.content:
Chapter 78: Chapter 72: An Ant Gazing at the Sky
"Master, can you let me feel the power of heaven and earth again?" Ning Qi’s words interrupted Taoist Longshan’s thoughts.
Ning Qi’s eyes were filled with curiosity.
Earlier was to test strength, but now he wants to experience the power of heaven and earth up close again. He had wanted to do this before, but Taoist Longshan was too busy and there was no opportunity.
Taoist Longshan’s face showed a smile, rarely showing a bit of eagerness.
Sometimes having a prodigy as a disciple is both a joy and a burden.
Taoist Longshan recalled that apart from having the opportunity to impart martial arts principles when Ning Qi first came into contact with the martial path, he could no longer find even a trace of accomplishment from Ning Qi, and even felt frustrated.
No matter what he taught, Ning Qi learned it quickly, sometimes even using it better than him with just a slight distraction.
Who can handle that?
But now.
The opportunity has come.
You must not have mastered the things of the Celestial Human Realm yet, right?
Taoist Longshan had a smile on his face.
"Of course you can, and it’s a good chance for me to explain the path of the Celestial Being to you in advance."
Ning Qi nodded repeatedly.
The master and disciple sat quietly by the cliff.
Although the cold wind was biting, to the two of them it was like a gentle breeze.
"The so-called Celestial Human Realm emphasizes leveraging human power to harness the power of heaven and earth. Human power is finite, but the power of heaven and earth is infinite. With the Divine Union Yuan Pill, resonate with the will of heaven and earth..."
Taoist Longshan patiently explained, his voice gentle, and he did not hold back, sharing all his insights from this period.
As he spoke, strands of the power of heaven and earth also coalesced, weaving around Ning Qi.
Though not as active as during his breakthrough, it was extremely gentle, unlike the violent force from before.
Listening, rays of spiritual light arose in Ning Qi’s mind.
Compared to when Taoist Longshan ascended to the Celestial Human Realm, Ning Qi’s comprehension had also improved considerably, and at a higher level, he gained different insights.
Unknowingly, Ning Qi had already closed his eyes.
The Celestial Being Unity Secret Technique began operating unconsciously, and he entered a magical state, with the power of heaven and earth around him becoming clearer.
"The power of heaven and earth is a mysterious force that permeates between heaven and earth, but before reaching the Celestial Human Realm, one cannot perceive it, let alone wield it early."
"Human power is finite, and heavenly power is infinite. The reason I can barely contend with a Celestial Being strong person now is because my Gang Qi is too abundant, but what if I could control some of the power of heaven and earth in advance? Perhaps the gap would be smaller."
"Divine Union Yuan Pill, but I don’t have a Yuan Pill yet; can something else be used as a substitute?"
...
Thoughts continuously arose in Ning Qi’s mind like a waterfall, having already entered a wonderful state of enlightenment.
Taoist Longshan, while explaining, sensed something was off.
He couldn’t help but twitch his beard.
"Has Jiu... achieved enlightenment?"
"And the force surrounding him is... the power of heaven and earth?!"
Taoist Longshan couldn’t help but draw a cold breath in his heart.
When Ning Qi demonstrated power not inferior to the Primordial Core Realm, he wasn’t this shocked, but seeing Ning Qi manifest control over the power of heaven and earth, he was truly stunned!
Advancing to the Celestial Human Realm?
Impossible.
That would mean Ning Qi had already formed a resonance with the power of heaven and earth before even reaching the Celestial Human Realm.
Unheard of.
Taoist Longshan’s heart was surging, unconsciously lowering his voice for fear of disturbing Ning Qi’s enlightenment.
Who knows how much time passed.
The sky gradually lightened.
Only then did Ning Qi slowly open his eyes.
There was joy in his eyes.
What Taoist Longshan imparted this time yielded great harvests!
Not only did he further understand the path to ascension of Celestial Being strong persons, but he also created this trump card secret technique.
The Heavenly Sword Technique.
This sword path secret technique was the result of Ning Qi’s attempt to manipulate the power of heaven and earth.
Only by being in a state of unity with heaven and man can one induce some power of heaven and earth, and then surround it with Gang Qi to form a Celestial Sword.
Ning Qi felt that even Celestial Being strong persons should avoid its edge.
Ning Qi bowed respectfully to Taoist Longshan as the rising sun gradually brightened:
"Thank you, Master, for imparting your teachings!"
Taoist Longshan inwardly gave a bitter smile, originally thinking he could use his Celestial Human Realm status to finally have a chance to impress his young disciple, only to be struck down again.
But he couldn’t help but ask:
"Qi’Er, that force surrounding you earlier was...?"
Ning Qi immediately realized and naturally took out a prepared manual from his bosom.
"I almost forgot to tell Master, this is the Celestial Being Unity Secret Technique I comprehended watching you break through the Celestial Human Realm, and I was about to give it to you."
The Heavenly Sword Technique was unique to the prodigy Ning Qi, who was in the Gang Essence Realm yet could manipulate the power of heaven and earth, so he did not give it to Taoist Longshan.
But the Celestial Being Unity Secret Technique, however, was acceptable for Taoist Longshan to use, and it might be greatly beneficial to him.
"The Celestial Being Unity Secret Technique?" Taoist Longshan was slightly taken aback, initially wanting to decline but instinctively accepted it.
He inhaled deeply and slowly opened the booklet.
"The root bone of man conceals the mystery of heaven and earth."
The opening statement struck him like a bolt of lightning, sudden enlightenment.
Taoist Longshan hungrily turned the pages, becoming completely immersed in it.
Who knows how much time passed.
He only raised his head, bewildered, from the book, his eyes full of shock.
The words "astonishing talent" could no longer suffice to describe this secret technique; such ingenuity would be unattainable even with hundreds of years, leaving him with an absurd feeling like an ant seeing the azure sky.
His face couldn’t help but show a faint hint of embarrassment, mind you, this secret technique was created by his young disciple.
Seeing the area devoid of people, with Ning Qi long gone, Taoist Longshan exhaled softly.The latest_epɪ_sodes are on_the Novᴇ(l)Fɪre .ɴᴇt
He looked towards the green mountain and burst into loud laughter.
He felt that taking Ning Qi as a disciple might be the best decision of his life.
...
After acquiring the Celestial Being Unity Secret Technique, Taoist Longshan began diligent research.
This secret technique made his comprehension of the power of heaven and earth much easier, and even improved his combat strength significantly. He felt that facing the Wang Family Ancestor again would certainly be much easier.
Until it was only one month before the Celestial Being Grand Ceremony.
Only then did Taoist Longshan set off down the mountain.
The Celestial Being Grand Ceremony required inviting several Celestial Being strong persons to attend, so he had to go personally. With his speed, it wouldn’t take too long.
Meanwhile, as True Martial disciples descended the mountain to deliver invitations and returned, the Martial Realm of Qing State became increasingly bustling, and the newly expanded True Martial City became more lively by the day.
Many eyes were set on True Martial Mountain, awaiting the arrival of the Celestial Being Grand Ceremony.
True Martial Mountain had become the focus of everyone’s attention.

chapters.title: Chapter 79 - 73 Little Meat Mountain
chapters.content:
Chapter 79: Chapter 73 Little Meat Mountain
In such an atmosphere, all the True Martial disciples were equally excited.
This gathering of heroes at True Martial Mountain can be said to be the largest event since the founding of the True Martial Sect, a turning point in the sect’s prosperity. Luo Wentian had issued multiple orders within the sect to welcome the arriving guests with the best essence, qi, and spirit, without any mistakes.
Luo Wentian remained stationed at True Martial Mountain, while Xiong Shi was dispatched to True Martial City.
Nowadays, more and more martial artists are gathering in True Martial City. Although many people will restrain themselves, conflicts are inevitable when crowds gather. Having a strong figure to maintain order is naturally better.
As for those stronger than Xiong Shi, they wouldn’t cause trouble either. Recently, the fearsome reputation of Taoist Longshan’s killings still lingered, and no one wanted to seek discomfort at this juncture.
Each disciple had their respective duties.
Ning Qi, on the other hand, found himself peaceful once more.
He wanted to help, but there was really nothing he could assist with, having hardly been involved in the sect’s affairs. Asking him to descend the mountain to deliver invitations was even less likely.
In the eyes of Luo Wentian and others, the little junior disciple was only eight years old, and it was better for him to stay within the sect.
Since that day when Taoist Longshan spoke about the Path of Celestial Being, Ning Qi seemed to comprehend something, creating the Heavenly Sword Technique, and then returned to his usual cultivation.
However, he felt the refining of Gang Qi to be somewhat slow.
"In the Gang Essence Realm cultivation, transform white mist into Jade Liquid, solidify Jade Liquid into Primordial Core; each realm is a qualitative change of Gang Qi. The Quenching Gang Pill is useful to me, but its consumption is too high. The sect’s foundation in spirit medicine cannot support my cultivation unless I descend the mountain to seek resources, but that may not be faster."
"Combining the previous Dreaming Gluttony Secret Technique, I might try to harvest energy for refining Gang Qi from food or other resources, but the problem is not fundamentally solved."
"Is there an inexhaustible supply of energy?"
Ning Qi fell into contemplation.
In fact, he had already thought of it, and that was the Power of Heaven and Earth.
Using the Power of Heaven and Earth to refine Gang Qi would definitely be effective.
But the problem is, his control over the Power of Heaven and Earth is entirely reliant on the Unity of Heaven and Man Secret Technique, merely able to roughly gather it into a mass like the Heavenly Sword Technique; it’s fine for combat but not precise enough for refining Gang Qi.
Ideas continually flashed in his mind, sweeping by one after another.
Ning Qi took a deep breath.
"Take it slowly."
This is a disparity in conditions, remedying it obviously isn’t easy.
However, Ning Qi felt that even if he continued to cultivate like this, breaking through to the Celestial Human Realm wouldn’t take too long, seven to eight years should suffice. Such a timeline is unparalleled across the world.
After all, even Taoist Longshan, known as an unparalleled genius, spent forty or fifty years before breaking into the Celestial Human Realm.
The challenge within is imaginable.
...
As time slowly passed.
As the eighth day of the twelfth lunar month approached, Taoist Longshan descended the mountain once more, and returned again, personally delivering invitations to several Celestial Human Realm experts, though how many would actually attend remained unknown. After all, Taoist Longshan had just stepped into the Celestial Human Realm, and his connections with these experts were mostly formed during past travels, with few truly close relationships.
The True Martial disciples who went out to deliver invitations had also returned to the mountain.Follow current novels on ɴoᴠel Fɪre.nᴇt
Ning Qi was no longer staying at the Seeking Tao Institute, as guests would soon be arriving on the mountain.
With cold weather and freezing days, heavy snow was flying in True Martial City, yet True Martial Mountain remained unaffected.
This was caused by Taoist Longshan’s prior manipulation of the Power of Heaven and Earth. Upon reaching the Celestial Human Realm, altering the heavenly phenomenon on a small scale was no longer difficult.
On True Martial Mountain.
The pavilions were renewed, and the disciples were exuberant in spirit.
Taoist Longshan in a white Taoist robe, graceful and immortal-like; all the True Inheritors in blue Taoist robes, while Inner and Outer Sect disciples wore dark and light green respectively.
It was three days before the Celestial Being Grand Ceremony.
True Martial Mountain welcomed its first guest.
The Divine Sword Sect.
The sturdily built and upright Divine Sword Old Man gazed at the familiar True Martial Mountain, his expression complex; originally thinking he’d have to wait for the next ten-year agreement to return, it was unexpected that after only three years, he was back already.
"Longshan... Old Dao."
Divine Sword Old Man ultimately refrained from calling him ’bull nose,’ substituting ’Old Dao’ instead, as Taoist Longshan had now reached the Celestial Human Realm, and the gap between them had grown substantial.
Taoist Longshan laughed heartily, showing no airs of a Celestial Human Realm expert:
"Divine Sword Brother, this is not like you at all."
Divine Sword Old Man’s eyes widened, snorted coldly:
"Longshan Old Dao, don’t get complacent, give me a few years and I will surely surpass you!"
He remained as stubborn as ever.
His gaze fell on the disciples behind Taoist Longshan, sensing several Gang Essence Realm auras, he sighed inwardly before looking at the youngest boy.
Ning Qi.
The Divine Sword Old Man’s eyes narrowed, noticing no change in Ning Qi’s physique, still the same balance as always.
"Could it be he hasn’t grasped the Dreaming Gluttony Technique?"
He was somewhat puzzled, given Ning Qi’s comprehension, it shouldn’t be so. Three years ago, his young disciple Zhuang Chen displayed a sword strike that continued to amaze him.
But before he could ponder further.
Taoist Longshan was already laughing and pulling him inside.
The two elders led the way, while the disciples followed closely behind.
However, this time the disciples from the Divine Sword Sect were visibly more reserved, considering the True Martial Sect’s recent prominence, not only Taoist Longshan stepping into the Celestial Human Realm, but also the emergence of several Gang Essence Realm experts.
Only one remained unaffected.
"Ning Qi, long time no see!"
Zhuang Chen’s excited voice rang out.
Ning Qi looked at the little mound of flesh in front of him, somewhat amazed.
If the Zhuang Chen of three years ago was just a chubby boy, now he was truly a big chunk.
Eleven-year-old Zhuang Chen was about the same height as Ning Qi, but his width was over twice Ning Qi’s, yet he still had a goofy face, and his uniform of the Divine Sword Sect looked comically stretched.
"Zhuang Chen?"
"Indeed, indeed."
Zhuang Chen nodded repeatedly, though excessively plump, he wasn’t greasy; his movements made the flesh jiggle, adding a touch of humor.
The two lagged behind, while the other disciples merely exchanged knowing smiles.
"Did you cultivate Dreaming Gluttony to achieve this?" Ning Qi couldn’t help but ask.
Zhuang Chen scratched his head and chuckled:
"That’s part of it, and also because I’ve grown to enjoy eating more."
He looked a bit puzzled.
"Ning Qi, didn’t you cultivate Dreaming Gluttony? Why haven’t you gotten fat at all?"
Before Ning Qi could respond.
He continued:
"If you didn’t cultivate it, then let me tell you, you definitely can’t beat me now. Secretly, I’m almost at the Inner Essence Realm, my master told me not to disclose it to others."
Well, still as talkative as ever.
Yet Ning Qi glanced at Zhuang Chen, slightly surprised too, with a flawless physique perhaps soon generating Inner Strength; his rate of cultivation didn’t match Ning Qi’s, but compared to normal people, was somewhat monstrous.
It appears Zhuang Chen is very compatible with the Dreaming Gluttony Secret Technique.
However.
What intrigued Ning Qi the most wasn’t Zhuang Chen’s compatibility with Dreaming Gluttony but rather the... Innate Sword Bone within him!

chapters.title: Chapter 80 - 74: Arriving as Promised
chapters.content:
Chapter 80: Chapter 74: Arriving as Promised
In front.
Senior Brother Dong He of the Divine Sword Sect, who was chatting with Luo Wentian, suddenly turned around and realized that his junior disciple was missing, and he was immediately startled.
Luo Wentian, however, smiled and held him back, saying:
"Don’t worry, it should be my junior disciple who took him to play, no need to worry."
Dong He immediately felt relieved.
He looked at Luo Wentian in front of him with some envy, even a bit of jealousy. He had heard that Taoist Longshan had made a great show of power at the Wang Family in Qing State, and in the end, the Wang Family even offered a Gang Condensing Pill as a gift, allowing Luo Wentian to successfully step into the Gang Essence Realm.
He is also now at the Realm of Perfection in the Inner Essence Realm, and if he had a Gang Condensing Pill, stepping into the Gang Essence Realm would not be difficult.
Unfortunately, he didn’t have the opportunity, as Gang Condensing Pills are incredibly precious.
He felt somewhat conflicted inside.
"Brother Dong? Brother Dong?"
"Rest assured, with my junior disciple there, there won’t be any problems."
Luo Wentian just assumed the other was worried about Zhuang Chen.
Dong He quickly waved his hand.
"Brother Luo, you worry too much. My junior disciple has been mentioning Ning Qi for the past three years, and now that they meet suddenly, being a bit close is normal, after all, they are just kids."
A smile appeared on his face.
...
At the Seeking Tao Institute at the moment.
Zhuang Chen was trembling.
Earlier, when Ning Qi suggested taking him to play at the Seeking Tao Institute, his eyes lit up, and he agreed without hesitation.
But at this moment.
Seeing Ning Qi’s smiling eyes, he felt a bit flustered, sensing a chilly aura.
"Ning... Ning Qi, what are you going to do?"
Ning Qi, seeing Zhuang Chen’s expression, couldn’t help but go speechless, as if he was going to do something weird.
He slapped Zhuang Chen on the forehead, speaking angrily:
"Teach you a secret technique related to the sword, do you want it?"
Zhuang Chen’s eyes suddenly lit up.
"Really?"
Three years ago, the sword technique Ning Qi taught him was treated as a treasure, and he had comprehended the Overbearing Sword Intent through it. Now hearing that Ning Qi was going to teach him a new Sword Path Secret Technique, he couldn’t help but rub his hands excitedly.
"How could I lie to you, but these few days, you need to cooperate with me for some research, and don’t tell anyone else. I promise this secret technique is much stronger than the previous sword I taught you."
Ning Qi really wasn’t lying to him.
Previously, exploring the physique of the White Ape, he created the powerful secret technique of the Ape King True Form. This time, by exploring Zhuang Chen’s physique, even if he can’t fully understand it, there will definitely be some gains.
If he really created a secret technique as strong as the Ape King True Form, Ning Qi wouldn’t be selfish to hide it.
Zhuang Chen was even more excited and nodded.
Beside them, Yuan Tiancheng was watching with a smirk. Although the Ape King True Form was great, the process was somewhat torturous.
"Sit tight."
Ning Qi said, slowly raising his hand and placing it on Zhuang Chen’s back.
The next moment.
Strands of Gang Qi surged from Ning Qi’s palm, infiltrating Zhuang Chen’s body. Gang Qi was metamorphosed from Inner Strength, naturally having the same effects, but Ning Qi once probed the White Ape’s body with Gang Qi and found it powerless against the essence of bloodlines, so he temporarily gave up.
However, now touching the surface was no problem.
"Ah!"
Zhuang Chen let out a cry, his whole body trembling, instinctively wanting to break free. Fortunately, Ning Qi’s power suppressed him, making him unable to move an inch.
Zhuang Chen immediately realized and held still despite it.
A strange sensation arose from his body, unbearably itchy and slightly sore and weak. When Ning Qi was probing, the Gang Qi would constantly vibrate within the flesh and meridians, creating a somewhat sour sensation.
Zhuang Chen looked at the schadenfreude White Ape, feeling miserable, but the promise of the Sword Path Secret Technique was alluring enough for him to endure.
He didn’t know how much time had passed.
Zhuang Chen was already drenched in sweat, just about to reach his limit.
Ning Qi finally withdrew his right hand.
Before Zhuang Chen could ask anything, Ning Qi had already sat cross-legged and slowly closed his eyes.
"Innate Sword Bone... basically, it’s a special physique among humans. People with this physique have remarkable sensitivity towards the Sword Dao, and even possess an extra boost when using Sword Dao Ultimate Skills."
"This always seemed somewhat similar to the bloodline of Heavenly Beasts. Could it be that the Human Race once had ’those favored by the heavens,’ similar to ’Celestial Beings’? Extraordinary innate talents? But if so, every Human Race should have such a powerful bloodline, so why so rare?"
"However, a physique sensitive to the Sword Dao also feels like it might be acquired postnatal. Could it be that among Zhuang Chen’s ancestors, there was a Heaven-Reaching powerhouse who cultivated to an unprecedented realm and even altered their own bloodline?"
Ning Qi found the Innate Sword Bone intriguing, not quite understanding it, mainly due to too little information.
He had various guesses in his heart, but eventually abandoned them.
"Forget it, let’s first comprehend this Innate Sword Bone. Upon probing, Zhuang Chen’s physique is indeed different from ordinary people, especially near the bones, there are peculiar fluctuations that resonate with the tendons and flesh. This might be one of the reasons for the mystical manifestation of the Innate Sword Bone."
Ning Qi’s mind was constantly sparked with inspiration.
He had previously contemplated creating a secret technique to cultivate Postnatal Sword Bone, but now it seems too distant. First, understand these peculiar fluctuations, then it won’t be hard to create a powerful Sword Path Secret Technique.
Time flowed by.
Zhuang Chen’s stomach had long started growling with hunger, but he dared not disturb Ning Qi.
Finally.
Ning Qi opened his eyes, with Zhuang Chen eagerly asking:
"How is it?"
Ning Qi smiled:
"I have some clues, but you’ll need to cooperate with me a few more times."
With the experience of the Ape King True Form behind him, Ning Qi was much more familiar this time, even to the extent that if not for worrying about Zhuang Chen’s body, he could continue probing with Gang Qi. After all, his current Gang Qi strength compared to the previous Inner Essence Realm is vastly different.
Zhuang Chen immediately showed a bitter face.
But thinking that if he gave up halfway, the Sword Path Secret Technique would be ruined, he could only grit his teeth and agree.
"Come on, let’s eat." Ning Qi said, hearing Zhuang Chen’s stomach growl, and laughed.
Upon hearing this, Zhuang Chen eagerly followed.
...
Disciples of the Divine Sword Sect were accommodated in the guest quarters.
For the following three days.
Ning Qi would take Zhuang Chen to the Seeking Tao Institute every day for a two-hour study. Zhuang Chen was both in pain and joy, with a chicken leg dangling in front of him, he had to grit his teeth and endure.
Ning Qi estimated that another one or two days would be enough. He planned to find an excuse for Zhuang Chen to stay a few more days on True Martial Mountain after the Celestial Being Grand Ceremony ended.
He felt that this Sword Path Secret Technique was extremely suitable for a Swordsman, capable of greatly amplifying Sword Dao Ultimate Skills, and was somewhat looking forward to it.
And during these three days.
One renowned force after another from Qing State also arrived successively, and normally rare to see Gang Essence Realm powerhouses were now everywhere, with quite a few Primordial Core Realm experts as well.The source of thɪs content is NovᴇlFɪre.ɴet
Those invited were either prominent figures, righteous figures with widespread good reputation, or at least from influential forces, where the elders would bring some disciples to broaden their horizons.
Meanwhile, some Martial Artists who, due to various reasons, couldn’t ascend the mountain gathered in True Martial City.
They waited eagerly, as they could hear news passed down from the mountain in real-time here.
The eighth day of the twelfth lunar month.
Arrived as promised.

chapters.title: Chapter 81 - 75: Gathering of the Strong
chapters.content:
Chapter 81: Chapter 75: Gathering of the Strong
In True Martial City, heavy snow was falling, yet it could not dampen the enthusiasm of the martial artists. Inns were overflowing, and people were warming themselves with wine, engaging in hearty discussions. Special couriers traveled between the mountain top and bottom to ensure the latest news reached them promptly.
This was why people flocked to this place even if they couldn’t ascend the mountain—they could get firsthand information.
Meanwhile, on True Martial Mountain.
The sky was clear.
The mountain top and bottom seemed like two different worlds. Seen from afar in the sky, there was a very distinct dividing line.
Above the True Martial Dojo.
Tables were arranged according to a special pattern. Over the past three days, guests had arrived and were seated under the guidance of True Martial disciples. At the center was a high platform, currently empty.
But when everyone looked at that high platform, their eyes bore a look of reverence. They knew who would sit there shortly, and an anticipation rose in their hearts.
Guests kept arriving.
"Mist Rain Pavilion of Cang State comes to offer congratulations!"
Luo Wentian’s voice rang out, drawing many gazes over.
Luo Wentian made a gesture, and several graceful women in white dresses came from the foot of the mountain. Their elegant steps and ethereal presence radiated an unparalleled charm. Even though they were all veiled in white silk, it was clear these women were beauties of the highest order.
Some young people brought by their elders for knowledge and experience were staring and bashfully lowered their heads.
Ning Qi curiously observed the leading woman. She was also in a white dress but had an embroidered crescent moon.
He wasn’t amazed by the lady’s grace but rather her unconcealed aura, which was at the Primordial Core Realm, comparable to the Divine Sword Old Man.
Ye Qinghe came over with a smile and said:
"That’s the Second Pavilion Master Liu Mingyue of Mist Rain Pavilion. Don’t be fooled by her youthful appearance; she’s almost the same age as our Master. Last time, when our Master pursued the Iron Ridge Three Fierce to Cang State, Mist Rain Pavilion helped us a lot."
Ning Qi understood and replied with a laugh:
"Pavilion Master Liu is impressive, but she’s not even a tenth of our senior sister."
Beside them, Zhuang Chen wiped his mouth and nodded repeatedly, making Ye Qinghe feel pleased. She laughed and called them ’two little tricksters,’ before running off to greet more guests.
There were more forces arriving today than in the previous three days, especially those coming from distant places.
"Ascetic Sect of Yun State comes to offer congratulations!"
...
"Nocturnal Blade Sect of Chu State comes to offer congratulations!"
...
"Sea-covering Gang of Cang State comes to offer congratulations!"
...
"Gu Buyi of Three-Eyed Divine Fist comes to offer congratulations!"
...
"Ye Chen of Gale Swift Sword comes to offer congratulations!"
...
Powerful forces and renowned figures kept arriving, among them were many first-rate, and even top-notch, forces. Though the Celestial Being Strong Persons did not come in person, they sent significant representatives to attend.
As for those strong loose cultivators, the weakest were at the Jade Liquid Realm, and many at the Primordial Core Realm.
Every time a notable strong person arrived, it caused an uproar.
Ning Qi noticed that most attendees were from Qing State, Yun State, Cang State, and Chu State. The True Martial Sect was located at the junction between Qing State and Yun State, so the most came from these two states. As for Chu State and Cang State, those were places where Taoist Longshan had traveled extensively in the past, building many connections.
The sun gradually rose in the east.
True Martial Mountain grew ever more bustling.
Ning Qi was in a good mood, not only because today was his master’s Celestial Being Grand Ceremony but also because many guests brought gifts, including many Martial Arts manuscripts. Gifts presented at today’s Celestial Being Grand Ceremony were naturally not ordinary items.
Ning Qi had long read all the scriptures in the Scripture Pavilion over the years, and this fresh wave of additions naturally made him happy.
He stood aside with Zhuang Chen, accompanied by the White Ape, occasionally drawing looks from others.
However, he remained calm and composed.
Suddenly.
He raised an eyebrow and looked towards the sky.
The previously noisy True Martial Dojo fell silent, as an indescribable wave emanated from the distant sky. Every gaze was involuntarily drawn, including those of the Primordial Core experts.The most update n0vels are published on ɴo(v)elFɪre.ɴet
Amidst widespread attention.
A figure stepped through the air—no, to be precise, there were three figures.
A middle-aged man in white, of unremarkable appearance, but flanked by a stunning woman on each side. The two women were strikingly similar and of considerable cultivation—they were a pair of lovely twins.
At the moment, the three were somewhat oblivious to their surroundings. The two stunning women held spirit fruits and fine wine, serving him gently, fingers lightly stroking, and offering kisses now and then, with fragrance wafting around.
Such a scene made many young people extremely envious, yet their elders looked on with reverence.
For someone to carry themselves in such a way, they must be an unmistakable Celestial Human Realm expert.
Some well-informed individuals had already identified the newcomer, a look of realization appearing in their eyes.
At first sight, the three were still a distance away, but with a blink, they were already at the foot of True Martial Mountain.
Taoist Longshan soared into the air, appearing in everyone’s line of sight, and he actively greeted the middle-aged man, laughing heartily:
"Carefree Brother, you’ve come in person, I’m truly grateful!"
His words revealed the visitor’s identity.
Ren Xiaoyao, known as the Carefree Monarch, led a carefree and romantic life, yet possessed a dash of heroism. His experiences had a bit of a legendary flavor; he came from a loose cultivator background, yet had constant fortuitous encounters, eventually reaching the Celestial Human Realm—a role model for countless loose cultivator martial artists.
The Carefree Monarch also laughed heartily:
"Your Celestial Being Grand Ceremony, Junior Brother Longshan, of course, I must attend. I thought I’d be delayed after fetching a jug of fine wine from Moon Viewing Tower in Yun State, but it turns out I’m the first to arrive?"
Everyone was enthralled. The ’first to arrive’ the Carefree Monarch mentioned naturally referred to being the first among Celestial Human Realm experts. In their eyes, only peers in the same realm were worth their attention.
There is a saying that goes, below the Celestial Being, all are insignificant.
Even a Primordial Core realm martial artist could only garner slight attention from a Celestial Human Realm expert, unless they showed potential to reach that realm, in which case they might receive special notice.
One who cannot perceive the Power of Heaven and Earth is ultimately not a true strong person.
Taoist Longshan gestured:
"Carefree Brother, please!"
The two took their seats on the central high platform, chatting and laughing, with their Celestial Human nobility captivating everyone.
Ning Qi observed curiously from afar. The aura of this Carefree Monarch was not concealed; he seemed slightly stronger than Taoist Longshan, but not by much.
Taoist Longshan had told Ning Qi that cultivating in the Celestial Human Realm was far more challenging. Often, one might stagnate for decades, and many exhausted their potential upon barely reaching the Celestial Human Realm, making no further progress.
"It seems the Carefree Monarch’s early fortuitous encounters have limits, or perhaps his innate talent has reached a peak. It may not be long before my master surpasses him."
"I just wonder if my one strike of the Heavenly Sword Technique could injure him?"
This thought arose unprompted in Ning Qi’s mind. This was the second Celestial Human Realm expert he had seen, besides Taoist Longshan.

chapters.title: Chapter 82 - 76 Celestial Being List 33
chapters.content:
Chapter 82: Chapter 76 Celestial Being List 33
However, as this thought just arose, Ning Qi chuckled to himself, realizing he unbeknownst had such a comparison in mind, perhaps due to the subtle sense of crisis evoked by the Celestial Human Realm strong person.
The arrival of the Carefree Monarch elevated the atmosphere of the True Martial Dojo to a higher level.
Especially some strong loose cultivators, whose gazes were filled with fervor; some attractive ladies also had a glimmer of affection in their eyes.
It is said that the Carefree Monarch has never accepted disciples but is fond of female beauty. However, every woman who follows the Carefree Monarch gains substantial benefits, like the current twin sisters who are beneficiaries.
The Celestial Being Grand Ceremony, to put it plainly, is a massive arena for fame and fortune, where everyone seeks what they need.
Taoist Longshan and True Martial Sect use this opportunity to display their foundation and become renowned worldwide, while others take the chance to network, gain insights, and explore any opportunity to acquire a bit of Celestial Being fortune.
At this moment.
Carefree Monarch and Taoist Longshan had just sat down, but simultaneously, they stood up again, exchanged a smile, took a step, and appeared outside the Tao Field.
Everyone’s gaze trembled, then followed.
Then they saw an old Taoist with crane-like features appear from the horizon. Dressed in a purple robe, holding a duster, with white hair and beard, he had even more Taoist charm than Taoist Longshan.
"Taoist Friend Longshan, I am late, please forgive!"
"Carefree Monarch, greetings."
The old Taoist showed no arrogance, spoke with a cheerful smile, yet Taoist Longshan and Carefree Monarch showed no neglect.
"True Man Baihe, thank you for your kindness." Carefree Monarch cupped his hands and said.
"Taoist Friend Baihe’s presence here is an acknowledgment of my True Martial Sect as a Tao Sect courtyard; I am grateful." Taoist Longshan sincerely expressed thanks.
This remark stirred everyone internally, with some already realizing something, faces full of amazement.
Luo Wentian noticed Ning Qi’s puzzled expression and whispered:
"Little Junior Brother, you might not know. Although our True Martial Sect is a Taoism sect, to rank among the top Tao sects in the world requires support from top Taoist forces. True Man Baihe is a member of the True Profound Sect, ranked fifth in the world."
"Master specially invited them; his lifelong wish is to become the best Tao sect in the world and revive the glory of True Martial."
Ning Qi immediately understood.
In the past, the True Martial Sect didn’t even have a Celestial Human Realm individual, making competing for Taoist rankings an unrealistic dream. But now things are different; with Taoist Longshan reaching the Celestial Human Realm, planning naturally begins.
However.
With the current foundation of True Martial Sect, let alone being the best Tao sect, even getting into the top ten is difficult.
It still requires gradual effort.
True Man Baihe landed beside Carefree Monarch and Taoist Longshan; none of the three sat down, but instead gazed towards the mountain, and Ning Qi also sensed before anyone else.
In the midst of everyone’s confusion.
A group approached quietly from the foot of the mountain, comprising elderly, middle-aged, and young individuals, all carrying a faint sense of superiority, the centerpiece being a luxurious litter carried by robust youth, the ’Wang’ character on their sleeves revealing their identity.
Qing State Wang Clan.
Everyone’s gaze turned strange.
After all, the previous feud between Taoist Longshan and the Wang Clan was well-known throughout the Martial Realm. Though it was said that the two families had reconciled, they were not expected to be so friendly. Many originally believed the Wang Clan would not show up when they delayed their arrival.
But now, seeing the grand display, it’s evident they made quite an effort.
Everyone looked towards the litter, already guessing the person’s identity.Thᴇ link to the origɪn of this information rᴇsts ɪn NovᴇlFɪre.ɴet
And Taoist Longshan’s words confirmed their speculation:
"Ancestor Wang’s presence amidst his busy schedule to True Martial Mountain is truly awe-inspiring for Longshan."
He smiled, yet internally puzzled; logically, someone of Ancestor Wang’s advanced age would rarely venture out, especially given the recent conflict with the Wang Clan—sending a Gang Essence Realm master would have already been quite respectful, yet unexpectedly Ancestor Wang came personally.
A hoarse laugh emerged from within the litter:
"I promised to attend your Celestial Being Grand Ceremony before; a person must keep their word."
As he finished speaking, a richly dressed old man appeared before everyone, occasionally coughing, his style differing somewhat from the other three Celestial Human Realm masters, but none underestimated him.
In the previous battle, Ancestor Wang’s miraculous life reversal was also widely known in the Martial Realm; everyone knew Ancestor Wang feared Taoist Longshan’s potential rather than his current strength.
"Ancestor Wang is genuinely trustworthy." Carefree Monarch and True Man Baihe praised with a smile.
Ancestor Wang glanced at the other three Celestial Beings, a hint of joy surfacing in his eyes; both Carefree Monarch and True Man Baihe displayed formidable power.
The rest were quite excited.
At this point, three Celestial Beings had already arrived, exceeding many people’s expectations. Initially, it was believed that someone like Taoist Longshan, with no solid foundation, would attract at most one or two Celestial Beings to support the event.
The four Celestial Beings standing there emitted an unparalleled aura, stirring many individuals profoundly.
Yet some wondered why, with the auspicious timing approaching, the four had not yet taken their seats.
"Taoist Friend Longshan, could someone else be coming?" True Man Baihe curiously asked.
Taoist Longshan smiled mysteriously:
"An elder is coming."
His eyes revealed anticipation.
Curiosity arose in several hearts; someone being addressed as an elder by Taoist Longshan in such a setting must be extraordinary.
Previously, addressing Ancestor Wang as an elder during the Wang Clan dispute was merely out of courtesy; in reality, most Celestial Human Realm masters are peers, with very few truly deserving the title of elder.
Ancestor Wang’s heart couldn’t help but skip a beat, slightly exhilarated.
Time passed.
The Golden Crow almost hung vertically.
Suddenly, a ’moo’ sound echoed, clear and piercing through the sky.
Many people shivered, and the expressions of the Celestial Human Realm masters took on a hint of respect, even Ning Qi’s eyes showed seriousness.
Among the previously arrived Celestial Beings, Carefree Monarch, True Man Baihe, Ancestor Wang, and his own master might have varying strengths but overall remain within one tier, with Ning Qi feeling he could handle them to some extent.
But now, facing this individual—not even visible yet—that faint sense of pressure made him extremely vigilant.
All eyes focused, and at the end of their vision, a figure riding a cyan bull slowly emerged.
The clear ’moo’ sound earlier was emitted by this cyan bull, its fur smooth as jade, eyes like brown glaze filled with innocence and wisdom, its aura strong, marking it as an Exotic Beast at first glance.
Upon the cyan bull’s back, an elder with closed eyes seemed in deep sleep; behind him was a blade, unsharpened.
The cyan bull let out another ’moo’, and the elder slowly opened his eyes, a trace of confusion flickered before noticing the bustling scene upon True Martial Mountain.
"We’ve arrived, indeed arrived. Good bull, go play."
Yawning with a smile, he leaped off the bull’s back like a simple farmer, as if disregarding everyone at the True Martial Dojo.
Yet, none of the Celestial Beings dared harbor any resentment.
For the elder riding the cyan bull was ranked thirty-third on Great Yan’s Celestial Being List.
Cyan Bull Blade Master.

chapters.title: Chapter 83 - 77 Heavenly Gang and Earthly Fiends Sword Array
chapters.content:
Chapter 83: Chapter 77 Heavenly Gang and Earthly Fiends Sword Array
"Greetings, Cyan Bull Senior!"
Both Taoist Longshan and Carefree Monarch, as well as True Man Baihe, slightly bent forward to show respect.
Taoist Longshan said with a smile:
"Today, with the presence of Cyan Bull Senior, my Celestial Being Grand Ceremony can truly be considered complete."
Only Ancestor Wang felt somewhat awkward because his age was indeed greater than Cyan Bull Blade Master. Addressing him as ’Senior’ seemed a bit odd, yet doing nothing would appear too casual. He could only muster a cheerful smile.
However, Ancestor Wang felt more joy than awkwardness within his heart.
He never imagined that Taoist Longshan could invite a powerful figure on the Celestial Being List to stand forth, making his attendance truly worthwhile. The corners of his mouth slightly lifted, and his smile carried more genuine delight.
Everyone present held an expression of awe in their gazes.
A powerful figure from the Celestial Being List.
Virtually considered to be at the pinnacle of Great Yan, in an era where Martial Saints rarely emerged, those thirty-six figures were the strongest.
Even though Cyan Bull Blade Master was only ranked thirty-third, Taoist Longshan and the four Celestial Human Realm experts combined would be effortlessly suppressed.
Ning Qi slowly withdrew his gaze to avoid being detected by Cyan Bull Blade Master.
He could feel the subtle pressure, especially from the formidable Bladeless Blade behind the elder, causing him some amazement at the remarkable Blade Intent nurtured within.
"Master once said that the Celestial Human Realm is quite unique. Some only cultivate one realm, some two, and others cultivate all three realms simultaneously, and the sequence of cultivation differs. Hence, their combat capabilities are not as straightforward as those in the Gang Essence Realm."
"Determining who is stronger among Celestial Human Realm experts requires actual combat unless their paths are similar. For most, it’s evaluated based on past achievements, thus giving rise to the Celestial Being List."
"The Celestial Being List is issued by the Great Yan Royal Family. Those who make it onto the list are the top-tier experts of the Celestial Human Realm, enjoying utmost prestige."
Undoubtedly.
Cyan Bull Blade Master is currently the most powerful person Ning Qi has encountered.
Cyan Bull Blade Master gestured with a cheerful smile:
"All are in the Celestial Human Realm, so the title of Senior or not doesn’t matter. If you don’t mind, just call me Brother."
He gazed at Taoist Longshan with appreciation in his eyes:
"Longshan lad, years ago I believed your entry into the Celestial Human Realm was inevitable, but I didn’t anticipate it being ahead of what I imagined. It’s only a matter of time before you surpass me."
Such admiration startled the Celestial Beings present.
Clearly, the two shared an exceptional relationship.
Taoist Longshan laughed heartily:
"Cyan Bull Brother, you overpraise me. Catching up to you is unpredictable in terms of time."
He was somewhat emboldened. Years ago during his travels, he was rescued by Cyan Bull Blade Master in a crisis and received some guidance. Now, as these years have passed, he himself has stepped into the Celestial Human Realm; the sense of achievement is beyond words.
"Ladies and gentlemen, please be seated!"
With everyone now arrived, a total of five Celestial Beings occupied the central platform, instantly elevating the excitement within the Tao Field.
Taoist Longshan stood at the center, Cyan Bull Blade Master to his left, True Man Baihe to his right, with the others seated on the sides.
Excited glances were exchanged as conversations began.
No one anticipated so many Celestial Realm experts would descend upon today’s Celestial Being Grand Ceremony, nor have a powerful figure from the Celestial Being List present.
This news quickly spread throughout True Martial City, prompting Martial Artists unable to ascend the mountain to clench their fists in regret for missing today’s grand spectacle. Some even proclaimed it was worth coming despite not witnessing the Celestial Beings, as sharing the same realm was an honor to recount in days to come.
Ancestor Wang’s gaze displayed slight envy and jealousy.
Recalling his own Celestial Being Grand Ceremony three hundred years ago, there had been barely one Celestial Realm friend in attendance, with numerous promises made thereafter. Compared to Taoist Longshan’s current grandeur, it paled in comparison.
However, remembering the purpose of his visit, his mood relaxed considerably.
Time slipped by gradually.
Everyone at True Martial Dojo felt the change and quieted down.
Luo Wentian’s invigorating voice rang out:
"The auspicious hour has arrived, the Celestial Being Grand Ceremony officially begins!"
In an instant.
There were nine thunderous drumbeats heard throughout, stirring the crowd’s blood to unknown fervor.
Following this came the rise and fall of ceremonial music, originating from afar, immersing the senses.
Fine wine and gourmet dishes adorned the tables.
True Martial disciples dressed in ceremonial robes and holding ceremonial swords poured in; thirty-six from the Inner Sect, seventy-two from the Outer Sect, precisely matching the numbers of Heavenly Gang and Earthly Fiends.
"We offer our tributes to the Sect Leader!"
The True Martial disciples were spirited and the Sword Dance suddenly commenced, resembling the rising sun.
Despite lacking a murderous aura, the Sword Dance exhibited disciplined form, with the cooperation yielding intricate transformations. When employed in battle, it surely wouldn’t be ordinary; this was both a Sword Dance and a compelling Sword Array.
Everyone’s eyes gleamed brightly, despite them being only Body Tempering Realm and Inner Essence Realm Martial Artists, the exhibition truly embodied the True Martial Sect’s foundation.
Those with keen insight easily recognized these disciples possessed excellent foundations, capable of standing out as talented disciples within ordinary sects, yet True Martial Sect had so many.ɴᴇᴡ ɴᴏᴠᴇʟ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀʀᴇ ᴘᴜʙʟɪsʜᴇᴅ ᴏɴ ɴovᴇl(F)ɪre.ɴet
In an instant.
Many people’s perceptions shifted; originally believing True Martial Sect only produced an extraordinary talent like Taoist Longshan, now they saw that Taoist Longshan’s training of disciples was equally formidable.
Representatives of some long-standing forces looked grim; with the foundation True Martial Sect displayed, within a few decades, they would surely gain a firm foothold as a top dominion.
Ancestor Wang felt slightly bitter.
His greatest concern in recent years had been the lack of promising youth within the Wang Clan. How could a family’s talents compare to gathering talents from the world? Seeing the abundance of genius True Martial disciples today made him reconsider whether to introduce external fresh blood.
Yet, families differed from sects, for if too much external blood was integrated, if they gained power one day, would the Wang Clan still be the Wang Clan?
Cyan Bull Blade Master simply smiled and enjoyed the fine wine.
Meanwhile, True Man Baihe observed the Sword Dance of the True Martial disciples intently. As a practitioner of Taoism, he was particularly sensitive to the numerology of Heavenly Gang and Earthly Fiends, and as he watched closely, his astonishment deepened.
This Sword Array was not simple.
He couldn’t help but ask:
"Taoist Friend Longshan, might I inquire about this Sword Array...?"
His words drew the attention of several Celestial Beings.
Taoist Longshan said with a smile:
"This Sword Array, when unified, forms the Heavenly Gang and Earthly Fiends Sword Array. Divided, it becomes the Heavenly Gang Sword Array and the Earth Evil Demon Sword Array, enabling collective strength against adversaries, employing weak to overpower the strong; it’s just a strategic advantage. I hope Taoist Friend Baihe is amused."
Their exchange immediately garnered interest from the crowd; even Cyan Bull Blade Master squinted thoughtfully for a moment before bursting into laughter:
"Longshan lad, you’re being too modest. This Sword Array isn’t as simple as you claim. A fine example of using weak to overpower the strong. If half of this Heavenly Gang and Earthly Fiends Sword Array comprised Inner Essence Realm individuals, coupled with a few powerful hands, wouldn’t it be enough to challenge Gang Essence Realm Martial Artists?"
Carefree Monarch laughed as well:
"Such a remarkably brilliant creation garners admiration! Worthy of a grand toast!"
The Celestial Beings all discerned its subtleties, expressing amazement.
The gap between Inner Essence Realm and Gang Essence Realm was equally vast, yet this Sword Array wielded remarkable power, beyond ordinary.
Ancestor Wang casually asked:
"I hadn’t heard of True Martial Sect possessing such a Sword Array before, not even throughout Qing State. Otherwise, it should have already become renowned."

chapters.title: Chapter 84 - 78 Congratulations Gift
chapters.content:
Chapter 84: Chapter 78 Congratulations Gift
Several individuals were taken aback.
Originally they thought the Heavenly Gang and Earthly Fiends Sword Array was an ancient legacy that Taoist Longshan had obtained, but judging by Ancestor Wang’s words, that might not be the case.
Taoist Longshan pondered briefly, then smiled and said:
"Ancestor Wang truly has a keen eye. This sword array... was recently created."
Saying this.
He felt slightly guilty and discreetly glanced at his disciple Ning Qi. After noticing Ning Qi was paying no attention, he secretly breathed a sigh of relief.
Indeed.
The Heavenly Gang and Earthly Fiends Sword Array was actually created by Ning Qi some time ago and handed over to him. Ning Qi, sensing the impending assault of the Iron Ridge Three Fierce, realized other disciples could only watch helplessly when faced with such powerful figures, decided to devise this sword array. It allows them to combine their strength and overcome the strong with the weak, but outwardly it was declared to be the creation of Taoist Longshan.
Today is the Celestial Being Grand Ceremony, mainly meant to display the depths of the True Martial Sect. Naturally, Taoist Longshan wouldn’t humbly claim it was obtained elsewhere.
After all, he never mentioned who actually created it.
If others misunderstand, it’s not his concern.
At this moment.
Several celestial beings naturally assumed it was created by Taoist Longshan, considering he was the only celestial human realm cultivator in the True Martial Sect—could it truly be anyone else?
In an instant, True Man Baihe and others looked at Taoist Longshan with even more respect.
Able to create such a marvelous and unparalleled sword array, his comprehension must indeed be extraordinary.
True Man Baihe praised:
"No wonder our friend could so young tread upon the celestial human realm, such comprehension is far beyond me, one day our Taoism shall have another strong person!"
Earlier he thought Cyan Bull Blade Master was merely supporting Taoist Longshan’s stance, but now he sees there’s possibly genuine sincerity within, realizing this he considers persuading the sect leader to support the True Martial Sect once returning to the True Profound Sect.
A stock with such potential, reaching the top tier of Taoism is simply a matter of time.
Carefree Monarch also sincerely praised:
"Brother Longshan creating such an unparalleled sword array truly garners my admiration, I, Ren Xiaoyao, throughout my life haven’t taken on disciples just because I feel my martial arts system is too scattered. If I had been like Brother Longshan, I might have been able to establish my own sect!"
Taoist Longshan, listening to everyone’s praises, felt a bit uneasy, responding only with continuous smiles.
In the audience, some also heard Carefree Monarch’s laughter.
Instinctively, the exclamations increased.
Vaguely heard phrases like ’True Man Longshan’s comprehension is unparalleled,’ ’True Man Longshan is truly extraordinary,’ making Taoist Longshan feel a bit hot-faced. If he were a fame-seeker it would be one thing, but now he’s simply trying to prevent his young disciple’s excessive prominence, feeling a bit roasted over a fire.
Ning Qi listened to the surrounding chatter, secretly chuckling in his heart.
Without needing to look, he knew exactly what his master was thinking, likely feeling a bit restless.
But it’s not a bad thing.
The increasingly cordial and friendly expressions of the surrounding martial arts strong individuals towards True Martial Sect disciples make it evident.
Fortunately.
The sword dance of the True Martial disciples ended quickly.
The atmosphere at the Tao Field filled with clinking cups became even more lively.
Someone began, prompting everyone to rise in unison, loudly congratulating:
"We congratulate True Man Longshan on entering the Celestial Being Realm, wishing you freedom and joy in the days ahead!"
With eyes filled with reverence and longing, the Celestial Human Realm enjoys eight hundred years of life, capable of soaring on the wind, altering heavenly phenomena—what difference in the eyes of ordinary people is there from Immortals and Gods?
After this Celestial Being Grand Ceremony, Taoist Longshan would be regarded as a True Man with respect, and for Taoism’s celestial beings, being regarded as a True Man is a form of honor, True Man Baihe’s presence acknowledged Taoist Longshan’s status as a True Man.
Taoist Longshan stroked his beard and laughed heartily:
"I sincerely appreciate everyone coming from far and wide, humbly request you to down this cup!"
His spirits were high, his mood exuberant.
Years of longing fulfilled in one day, now it’s about advancing his own cultivation while revitalizing the sect.
Everyone drank in one gulp, feeling the excitement of being part of such an event.
At this moment.
The Celestial Being Grand Ceremony had reached a climactic point, but the most anticipated aspect by everyone was not this.
What is the Celestial Being Grand Ceremony?
It is the celestial beings displaying their majesty and methods.
And celestial beings lecturing on the Dao is naturally an indispensable part.
Why do some Gang Essence Realm strong individuals, even Primordial Core Realm strong individuals travel thousands of miles for this moment? It’s for this—for the chance to hear celestial beings sharing breakthrough insights, or even fragments of celestial human realm realizations, enough for them to benefit for a lifetime.
Some lucky ones might even seize an opportunity from it to glimpse a spark of enlightenment towards the celestial human realm.
Moreover, new celestial beings also use this chance to ’bestow favor,’ consolidating their prestige and authority.
However.
Celestial beings lecturing on the Dao won’t be casual.
It requires the present guests to pay a ’tuition fee.’
Amount doesn’t matter, the intention is what’s significant, but most people prepare with great care. In such an occasion, gifting too inadequately can be embarrassing; in a sense, it’s likewise a perfect opportunity to elevate their own reputation.
Some guests feeling their gifts weren’t prestigious enough had already handed them to True Martial Sect disciples before arriving; those who hadn’t given by now likely have enough confidence in their gifts.
At this moment.
As everyone finished their congratulations.
The Sea-covering Gang Leader from Cang State stood up first, initially glancing around and apologetically clasping his hands:
"Fellow martial arts colleagues, I, Li Guangde, will humbly start by presenting my humble offering!"
He respectfully bowed to all celestial beings, then loudly congratulated:
"My Sea-covering Gang acquired a pair of top-grade Luminous Pearls not long ago, to congratulate True Man Longshan on entering the Celestial Being Realm!"
He slowly opened a Purple Gold Sandalwood Box revealing a pair of exquisite shining pearls into sight, immediately sparking murmurs of admiration especially from some female martial artists, their eyes showed a hint of infatuation.
These top-grade Luminous Pearls were splendid, even under the blazing sun they had a gentle shine, extremely extraordinary.
But everyone knew.
The Luminous Pearls weren’t merely attractive.
"Luminous Pearls belong to the water element, if martial artists cultivating water-related inner strength or Gang Essence wield them, their martial path will gain significant enhancement."Follow current novels on ɴovel(ꜰ)ɪre.nᴇt
"Sea-covering Gang sure spent big ears, it’s said they control much of the water territories around the Cang State area, their influence grows steadily, ranking top among first-class forces, and now it seems evident!"
"Tsk tsk, no wonder they dared to step out first, truly noteworthy."
In an instant.
The Sea-covering Gang gained much prominence, and its leader secretly delighted hearing the surrounding discussions, feeling this gift was worth giving.
In the realm of martial arts, it’s not only about fighting; often it’s about relying on reputation and face in actions.
Today Sea-covering Gang’s fame soared, known by more people, making future endeavors smoother for its members.
Even Ning Qi couldn’t help but glance at the pair of Luminous Pearls.
"If Luminous Pearls were ground into powder, they’d be an excellent medicinal catalyst, possibly useful in the future."
Although the Quenching Gang Pill’s effects are temporarily unsatisfactory, Ning Qi wouldn’t give up further research on the Alchemy Dao; if resources become abundant later, Alchemy Dao substantially aids the Martial Path.
He senses.
After this Celestial Being Grand Ceremony, the True Martial Sect’s treasury might swell tremendously.
Taoist Longshan smiled and said:
"Gang Leader Li, much appreciated."
Sea-covering Gang Leader happily sat down understandingly, having made a worthy impression, since today’s protagonist wasn’t him.
Following Li Guangde, strong individuals within the Tao Field.
Also eagerly presented their gifts.

chapters.title: Chapter 85 - 79: Treasure Trove Harvest
chapters.content:
Chapter 85: Chapter 79: Treasure Trove Harvest
"Nocturnal Blade Sect presents three Bright Fruits to celebrate True Man’s ascension to the Celestial Being Realm!"
...
Exclamations erupted below once again.
From the murmured discussions, Ning Qi discerned the origin of the Bright Fruits. The founding site of the Nocturnal Blade Sect housed a Spirit Tree known as the Bright Tree, which radiated light day and night, turning the area into a place that never slept, hence the name, Nocturnal Blade Sect.
This Bright Tree bore fruit only once every ten years. The Bright Fruit had the effect of purifying the body, sharpening hearing and sight, and even slightly enhancing the consumer’s perception. It was undoubtedly a top-grade Spirit Fruit.
Ning Qi’s eyes sparkled.
"Perhaps I could take a Bright Fruit to study. If I could deduce the cultivation method, it might be applicable to the True Martial Peach Tree."
He was quite eager.
Today’s gathering of heroes presenting gifts was truly a bountiful harvest.
It surpassed his expectations.
Although the offerings were meant for Taoist Longshan, most would end up in the True Martial Treasure Vault. As a Path Guardian of the True Martial Sect, Ning Qi could naturally make use of them at will. In a way, these treasures might as well have been gifts to him.
He even thought about suggesting to his master to hold such Celestial Being Grand Ceremonies more frequently.
Of course, Ning Qi wasn’t a selfish person. The treasures he obtained would ultimately benefit the entire True Martial Sect.
...
"Mist Rain Pavilion of Cang State presents an Ice Silkworm Treasure Armor..."
...
"Ascetic Sect of Yun State presents a Relic Pill..."
...
"Divine Sword Sect presents a pair of famous swords..."
...
Exclamations continued to ring out.
Taoist Longshan was in high spirits.
Perhaps it was due to the recent battle where Taoist Longshan defeated Ancestor Wang, forcing the Wang Clan to lower their heads. Many factions had meticulously prepared congratulatory gifts, exceeding the usual standards for a Celestial Being Grand Ceremony.
This was only natural.
People always serve those who seem worthy.
Taoist Longshan showcased talents far surpassing an average Celestial Human Realm. Naturally, many wanted to hear him speak of the Tao and were willing to form such a connection.
Even the Cyan Bull Blade Master came to present a gift today, proving their perception was correct.
As the last person presented their gift,
silence enveloped the Tao Field.
Yet, the gazes weren’t focused on Taoist Longshan but instead on the other four Celestial Beings.
Only the gifts from these four remained.
True Man Baihe, feeling the weight of many gazes, smiled warmly.
He respectfully addressed those present:
"Might I be the first to offer my humble gift?"
"Please, True Man!"
True Man Baihe smiled serenely:
"Both the True Profound Sect and the True Martial Sect belong to Taoism. Today, the True Profound Sect offers twelve hundred volumes of Taoist Scripture as a gift. I hope True Man Longshan will accept them graciously."
Taoist Longshan waved his hands repeatedly.
"True Man Baihe, your gift leaves me eternally grateful!"
Joy shone in his eyes, as the gift resonated deeply with him.
While he had inherited the True Martial legacy, it was mostly martial arts-focused; his foundation in Taoist Scripture wasn’t as profound. Today’s gift from the True Profound Sect, with its twelve hundred volumes, significantly boosted his foundation.
True Profound Sect wouldn’t present anything casually, ensuring many rare and unique texts among the gift.
More crucially, this represented the support of the True Profound Sect. In the future, the True Martial Sect would not stand alone among Taoism.
Ning Qi’s eyes also brightened.
He had already perused all the classics within the Scripture Pavilion. This additional twelve hundred volumes of Taoist Scripture would greatly enhance his foundation. Compared to martial arts classics, Ning Qi preferred reading Taoist Scripture as they elucidated many profound truths, offering nourishment at critical moments.
These were the sources and sustenance for his enlightenment and creation techniques.
However, both master and disciple were unaware that the original gift from the True Profound Sect was only eight hundred volumes. Upon seeing the Cyan Bull Blade Master and witnessing the revealed foundations of the True Martial Sect, True Man Baihe discreetly added four hundred more volumes. Further volumes were already on their way, unknown to anyone, to be expedited at a later date.
This unpretentious gift was impeccable, leaving no room for criticism.
Carefree Monarch laughed heartily:
"With True Man Baihe’s gem before me, my gift seems rather inadequate."
Everyone smiled.
Carefree Monarch took out a jade box from his bosom, opening it to reveal a fiery red Crystal Stone.
"This is the Thousand-Year Flame Sun Jade, known for nurturing the body and enhancing Essence Yuan. I’ve heard that Brother Longshan wishes to cultivate the Celestial Being Three Realms. I offer this gift to wish him smooth sailing ahead!"
Taoist Longshan was visibly moved.
The gift was significant, but the sentiment was even greater.
Carefree Monarch was known for his carefree nature. If he acknowledged you, even a roadside beggar could be his brother. Taoist Longshan had met him during a past adventure, leading to today’s friendship.
The role of the Thousand-Year Flame Sun Jade wasn’t just as Carefree Monarch had lightly described.
For those cultivating the Flower of Essence at the Celestial Human Realm, it offered substantial enhancement and was undoubtedly a Supreme Treasure.
The envy in Ancestor Wang’s eyes was subtly apparent.
"Carefree Brother’s sentiment is deeply appreciated!"
Taoist Longshan’s expression was extremely serious.
Carefree Monarch merely laughed and waved it off.
Ancestor Wang withdrew his envious gaze and seamlessly continued the conversation.
"The gifts from True Man Baihe and Carefree Monarch leave this old man feeling inferior. For True Man Longshan’s Celestial Being celebration, I’ve prepared a seed of an Enlightenment Tea Tree. I hope True Man does not find it lacking."
There was an almost imperceptible hint of embarrassment on Ancestor Wang’s face.
Indeed, with such distinguished gifts preceding his, his own seemed rather insignificant.
An Enlightenment Tea Tree was indeed extraordinary, an exquisite Spirit Tree whose leaves could assist in enlightenment. In rare cases, the most refined leaves could bring one into a state of Enlightenment!
If Ancestor Wang had presented a fully-grown Enlightenment Tea Tree today, he would undoubtedly be the star of the event.
Alas.
It was merely a seed of the Enlightenment Tea Tree.
To plant and cultivate such a seed into a full tree would be exceedingly challenging, requiring unknown amounts of time and effort, with no guarantee of success.
In reality.
After acquiring this Enlightenment Tea Tree seed, the Wang Clan had attempted to cultivate it for a long time, even damaging its viability somewhat, with no success, hence why it was being given as a gift. Otherwise, Ancestor Wang would have been reluctant to part with it.
This gift resembled a grand promise; it sounded impressive but was superficial, easily seen through by those knowledgeable.
But how could these Celestial Beings not be knowledgeable?
Even some Primordial Core Realm martial artists bore peculiar expressions and quickly lowered their heads, pretending to drink to hide their reactions, lest Ancestor Wang noticed.ᴛhis ᴜpdated by NovᴇlFirᴇ.ɴet
Ancestor Wang felt a twinge of frustration. He had expected at most one average Celestial Human Realm at the ceremony. In such a case, the Enlightenment Tea Tree seed might have sufficed to save face. Who could have foreseen the presence of three Celestial Beings, including a powerhouse from the Celestial Being List?
This was beyond his expectations, leaving him between a rock and a hard place.
Taoist Longshan simply smiled gratefully:
"Thank you, Ancestor Wang."
He hadn’t anticipated anything overly precious from Ancestor Wang since he hadn’t expected Ancestor Wang to attend in person at all.
Presenting an Enlightenment Tea Tree seed was already satisfactory.

chapters.title: Chapter 86 - 80 Sermon
chapters.content:
Chapter 86: Chapter 80 Sermon
The crowd had different thoughts.
Some people, who had only heard of the Enlightenment Tea Tree, felt that Ancestor Wang was being very generous despite past differences, but those with more knowledge understood that this seed actually had little value. However, as it came from a Celestial Human Realm expert, no one dared to comment.
Ning Qi watched from below, and a look of anticipation flashed through his eyes.
Since he began researching and cultivating the True Martial Peach Tree, he had developed some insights in this area. Perhaps he could plant this Enlightenment Tea Tree seed, and even optimize it in the future.
At that time,
True Martial Sect could have one more foundation, and it could also help him attain enlightenment.
However, the specific process would still require understanding the condition of the seed.
Ancestor Wang’s nervousness did not last long, as gazes gradually shifted to Cyan Bull Blade Master.
Of all the Celestial Human Realm experts present, he had yet to present a gift. Coupled with his identity on the Celestial Being List, it made everyone look forward to what kind of treasure he would bring out.
Even True Man Baihe and the Carefree Monarch were somewhat curious.
After all, Celestial Being List experts were always mysterious, and opportunities to meet them were rare.
Cyan Bull Blade Master, unhurried, as if oblivious to others, kept eating large chunks of meat. After swallowing a mouthful of it, he exhaled and laughed loudly:
"Long Shan, I came in a hurry this time and did not prepare a proper gift for you. Luckily, on the way here, I encountered a vicious tiger harming people, so I took its Inner Core. Hold on to it, and I’ll give you a better gift next time."
As he spoke,
a lightning-infused Exotic Beast Inner Core hovered from Cyan Bull Blade Master’s hand, with an incredibly fierce aura, which faintly roared like a mighty tiger, causing even Gang Essence Realm experts to feel a slight tremor of mind.
True Martial Dojo gradually quieted, and many eyes fell on the lightning-infused Inner Core, full of awe and admiration.
"Beast King Inner Core!"
"Such ease and leisure, is this the strength of a Celestial Being List expert?"
"Could this be the Inner Core of the Thunder Tiger Beast King of Lei State? I once had the chance to glimpse it from a distance in Black Water Marsh. I never expected to see it again in this way; truly, things are unpredictable."
Whispering discussions continued, and the appearance of the Celestial Being List expert immediately overshadowed all previous contributions.
Ning Qi looked at that Inner Core, his eyes filled with amazement.
What qualifies as a Beast King?
Only exotic beasts that rival Human Race Celestial Being Realm experts can be called Beast Kings.
In other words,
This Cyan Bull Blade Master effortlessly slaughtered an exotic beast comparable to the Celestial Human Realm and presented its Inner Core as a gift, revealing his immense strength. Moreover, this Beast King Inner Core is incredibly precious.
Exotic Beast Inner Cores are already rare, only cultivated by outstanding exotic beasts. For instance, the previously developed Gang Condensing Pill by Ning Qi primarily used Exotic Beast Inner Cores. But using a Beast King Inner Core to refine a Gang Condensing Pill would be an overkill; it has more valuable uses.
"On that Inner Core, there seems to be lingering Power of Heaven and Earth?" Ning Qi’s eyes flickered, developing an unusual desire for the Inner Core.
Amid the exclamations,
Taoist Longshan expressed his gratitude emotionally:
"Cyan Bull Brother’s presence at True Martial Mountain is already the most precious gift!"
This was not mere flattery.
The news of Cyan Bull Blade Master attending Taoist Longshan’s Celestial Being Grand Ceremony would ensure that any other Celestial Human Realm who contemplated moving against True Martial Sect would weigh the significance of this Celestial Being List expert.
Cyan Bull Blade Master just smiled and waved his hand.
He had long favored Taoist Longshan.
Now it was further proof that his judgment was accurate.
On the True Martial Dojo,
the crowd was still somewhat immersed in awe.
One treasure after another broadened everyone’s horizons, which is one of the significances of attending grand events—gaining knowledge and having something to boast about later.
However,
